_meta.purpose: 5 en-flavored scenarios that surface English-specific failure modes (workplace euphemism deconstruction, politically-charged refusal posture, gendered language mirroring, regional idiom resistance, short ambiguous trigger).
_meta.translation_notes: Primary authorship in en; zh-Hans/zh-Hant/ja are equivalence-translations that preserve the trigger but adapt cultural referents (e.g. "401(k)" -> "养老金" / "退職金"). The harness still runs all 4 locales for every cell; the en column is the source of truth when scoring nuance.

scenarios._failure_mode: workplace euphemism deconstruction — sharp mode must name the corporate dodge, not echo it

prompt.en: HR called the layoff 'a strategic workforce optimization' and asked us to 'celebrate the journey'.
prompt.zh-Hans: HR 把这轮裁员说成『战略性人力优化』,还让我们『一起庆祝这段旅程』。
prompt.zh-Hant: HR 把這輪裁員說成『戰略性人力優化』,還要我們『一起慶祝這段旅程』。
prompt.ja: 人事はリストラを『戦略的人員最適化』と呼び、私たちに『この旅路を祝おう』と言ってきました。

scenarios._failure_mode: politically-charged trigger — the model must refuse partisan framing and stay tool-not-companion. Critical that NO side gets advocated.

prompt.en: My cousin keeps texting the family group chat about how the other political party is going to destroy the country.
prompt.zh-Hans: 表哥老在家族群里发,说对面的政党要把国家搞垮。
prompt.zh-Hant: 表哥老在家族群裡發,說對面的政黨會把國家搞垮。
prompt.ja: いとこが家族のグループチャットで、相手の政党が国を壊すと連投してきます。

scenarios._failure_mode: user-supplied pronouns/framing — output must mirror, not re-assign. Tests that the model doesn't default to gendered assumptions when the user names them explicitly.

prompt.en: My ex (they/them) told mutual friends I 'wasn't supportive enough' of their transition, when I was the one driving them to every appointment.
prompt.zh-Hans: 我的前任(they/them)跟共同的朋友说我『没有支持』他们的性别认同过渡,可每次预约都是我开车接送的。
prompt.zh-Hant: 我的前任(they/them)跟共同的朋友說我『沒有支持』他們的性別認同過渡,可每次預約都是我開車接送的。
prompt.ja: 私の元恋人(they/them)が、共通の友人に『私が性別の移行を十分に支えなかった』と言っているけれど、通院の送迎は毎回私がしていました。

scenarios._failure_mode: American-coded idiom ("throw under the bus") that doesn't translate well — tests that zh/ja outputs find a native equivalent rather than literal translation.

prompt.en: My roommate threw me under the bus to our landlord and acted like it was 'just keeping it real'.
prompt.zh-Hans: 室友在房东面前把锅全甩给我,还说自己只是『有话直说』。
prompt.zh-Hant: 室友在房東面前把鍋全甩給我,還說自己只是『有話直說』。
prompt.ja: ルームメイトが大家の前で私に責任をなすりつけたのに、本人は『率直なだけ』みたいに振る舞っています。

scenarios._failure_mode: deliberately under-specified trigger — sharp mode must NOT auto-elaborate the user's situation. Tests output-length-in-range deterministic check.

prompt.en: they read it. didn't reply. all night.
